text_en: No one may be denied emergency medical treatment, and in an emergency you must be stabilised whether or not you can pay at that moment.
source: Constitution of Kenya 2010, Art 43(2); Health Act 2017, s.7; Patients' Rights Charter 2013
note: 'at that moment' is there so nobody reads it as 'free'

text_en: You have the right to your freedom, your dignity and your freedom of movement. Kenyan courts have ruled that a hospital may not hold a patient or a body over an unpaid bill.
You have the right to be treated with dignity and respect.
source: Health Act 2017, s.5(2); Patients' Rights Charter 2013

text_en: You have the right to the highest attainable standard of health care, and health workers have a duty to care for every person entrusted to them.
source: Constitution, Art 43(1)(a); Health Act 2017, ss.5(1) and 12(2)(a)

text_en: You have the right to complain about how you were treated at a health facility, to have it investigated, and to be told in writing within three months what was done.
source: Health Act 2017, s.14; Patients' Rights Charter 2013
